The '''Sevastol sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Benja-Rihn]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Carthasian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
